data.title: Ant International Secures Payment Institution Licence from the Central Bank of Brazil
data.description: Ant International, a top global provider of digital payment, digitization, and FinAI solutions, has recently acquired a Payment Institution (PI) license from the Central Bank of Brazil. This development allows them to enhance their global payment and account services for enterprises, platforms, and SMEs operating in Brazil’s thriving digital economy. This license solidifies their position as a key player in the industry and showcases their commitment to expanding their services in the country.
